description: Shell script for testing a git-svn interaction involving a repository with deleted and readded directories. It loads a repository dump, starts an svn server, initializes a git-svn connection, and fetches updates.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Ensures that the svn server port is open and accessible before running the tests.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts the svn server process needed for the test.
